items.title: Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s fate stretches into evening
items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会会议决定首席执行官黄仁勋的命运持续到晚上
items.summary: Nvidia's board is meeting days after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会召开会议几天前，首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报部门认为是中国间谍的女性有染。

items.title: The world's super-rich are piling into alternative investments. Here's why
items.title_zh: 全球超级富豪纷纷涌入另类投资领域。这就是为什么
items.summary: Alternative investments now account for 60% of single-family office portfolios, surpassing traditional assets for the first time, according to BNY Wealth.
items.summary_zh: BNY Wealth 的数据显示，另类投资目前占单一家族办公室投资组合的 60%，首次超过传统资产。

items.title: Lionsgate Acquires Alma Har’el’s ‘Wet’ Starring Connor Storrie, Rebecca Ferguson, Odessa A’zion and More
items.title_zh: 狮门影业收购阿尔玛·哈埃尔执导的《湿》，由康纳·斯托里、丽贝卡·弗格森、奥黛莎·阿齐恩等主演
items.summary: Lionsgate has acquired the North America and UK distribution rights to “Wet,” director Alma Har’el’s latest film, from Fifth Season and 193, A Legendary Company.
items.summary_zh: 狮门影业公司已获得导演阿尔玛·哈埃尔的最新电影《湿漉漉》第五季和《193，传奇公司》的北美和英国发行权。

items.title: Elon Musk says it would be an 'honor' to hire Nvidia's Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，聘请英伟达的黄仁勋将是一种“荣幸”
items.summary: The post on X comes amid reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang.
items.summary_zh: X 上的帖子发布之际，有报道称 Nvidia 董事会正准备罢免黄仁勋。

items.title: Keanu Reeves’ ‘Constantine 2’ Gets ‘Renewed Hope’ After James Gunn’s DC Exit, Says Director: ‘People at DC Were an Impediment to Us’
items.title_zh: 导演表示，基努·里维斯的《康斯坦丁2》在詹姆斯·冈恩退出华盛顿特区后获得了“新的希望”：“华盛顿特区的人是我们的障碍”
items.summary: Following the news that James Gunn and Peter Safran are out as co-studio heads at DC, “Constantine” director Francis Lawrence is feeling a “renewed hope” about his long-awaited sequel to the “Hellblazer”-inspired 2005 action-horror.
items.summary_zh: 在詹姆斯·冈恩和彼得·萨夫兰不再担任 DC 联合制片厂负责人的消息传出后，《康斯坦丁》导演弗朗西斯·劳伦斯对这部 2005 年《地狱神探》启发的动作恐怖片期待已久的续集感到“新的希望”。

items.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
items.title_zh: 谁能取代黄仁勋？可能的继任者名单非常不科学
items.summary: Nvidia has no succession plan and a CEO in hot water, so we’ve drafted a shortlist.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达没有继任计划，首席执行官也陷入困境，因此我们起草了一份候选名单。

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.title_zh: 正在展开的黄仁勋丑闻：时间表
items.summary: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 随着美国和中国竞相开发最先进的人工智能基础设施，这一事件可能会对国家安全产生影响。

items.title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 据报道，英伟达准备解雇黄仁勋
items.summary: Nvidia's board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report from the New York Times about a second alleged extramarital affair, just days after he admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, The Wall Street Journal reports.
items.summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，在《纽约时报》报道了黄仁勋第二次涉嫌婚外情的报道后，英伟达董事会正准备解雇首席执行官黄仁勋，而就在几天前，黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女性有另一段婚外情。
